title: DN200 90° Concrete Pump Elbow
seoTitle: DN200 R275 90° Pump Elbow | Pinjin Xingtai
description: The Xingtai elbow on this page is labelled DN200, R275, 90°, dedicated pump-truck pipe, with a heel bracket. Other diameters are quoted after the pump model. No list price and no small-batch shipping. It is not Electric 20’s 80 mm line.

relatedPaths.label: Concrete pump delivery pipe quote row

answerBlock.what: DN200 90° Concrete Pump Elbow is a wear pipeline spare part manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The factory label reads dedicated concrete pump-truck pipe, DN200, R275, 90°, with a triangular mounting bracket at the heel. Other diameters and radii are quoted after the pump model. No list price. Not sold in small batches.
answerBlock.who: Teams replacing a labelled DN200 / R275 / 90° bend, after quantity is confirmed.
factors: Label is DN200, not Electric 20’s 80 mm and not LZ-60’s 100 / 125 mm
R275 and 90° are on this piece; other radii are not printed
The DN80 clamp is a different SKU
No list price

faqs.question: What bend radius is printed on this elbow?
faqs.answer: R275 and 90°, nominal diameter DN200. The label reads dedicated concrete pump-truck pipe, with a heel bracket. Other radii are not on this page.

faqs.question: Does the DN200 elbow fit Electric 20’s 80 mm pipe without a quoted change?
faqs.answer: The site does not print that fit. Electric 20 lists 80 mm. This elbow is labelled DN200. Other diameters are quoted after the pump model. Do not assume the pieces mate.
